name: 1964 GEPD 0.8.5 - Auto-Mod Edition v0.1
body:
## About

This build automatically finds GoldenEye's relocated game segment and the correct firing-rate and Disable Head Roll patch points in ROM mods. Mouse Injector v0.2 also finds the mouse-control and manual-reload locations. **[Murk's RandomEye-zer v1.1 now works](https://www.moddb.com/mods/random-eye-the-true-randomizer/downloads/random-eye-zer-10)**, and other mods should no longer need their own hard-coded profiles. Invalid matches are skipped, retail GoldenEye/Perfect Dark support is unchanged, and the modern-build window background is fixed.

**Tested with:** GoldenEye 007 (USA), Perfect Dark (USA v1.1), Murk's RandomEye-zer v1.1, Bloodlust v1.06, King of the Hill v0.98, Cartridge Tilt, GE Stereo SFX, GE Compilation v1.1, GoldenEye Tower, Goldfinger 64, Netplay 60FPS LTK Cup Edition v1.1, Pheonaarx's Yet To Come, Project GoldenEye v2.1, RickRollEye 64, Tomorrow Never Dies 64 Expanded and The Spy Who Loved Me 64 Demo v1.

Please open an issue if a mod does not work or has glitches. Include its name/version, required base ROM and what happened. Do not upload ROM files. Mod-specific bugs should also be reported to the mod's developer.

## Setup

Install this over [Graslu's original 1964 GEPD package](https://github.com/Graslu/1964GEPD/releases/tag/latest). Close 1964, then drag the included `1964.exe` and `plugin` folder into your existing 1964 folder and allow both files to be replaced. **[Mouse Injector v0.2](https://github.com/Madcadden/mouse-injector/releases/tag/automatic-mod-compatibility-v0.2) is already included.** No ROMs are included.

[Graslu's Setup guide](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8mL0I__VMec) · [Graslu's 4K 60 FPS video demo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rxWkLdgdcPA&t=81s)
